function.name: process
function.description: Manage background processes started with terminal(background=true). Actions: 'list' (show all), 'poll' (check status + new output), 'log' (full output with pagination), 'wait' (block until done or timeout), 'kill' (terminate), 'write' (send raw stdin data without newline), 'submit' (send data + Enter, for answering prompts), 'close' (close stdin/send EOF).

action.description: Action to perform on background processes

session_id.description: Process session ID (from terminal background output). Required for all actions except 'list'.

data.description: Text to send to process stdin (for 'write' and 'submit' actions)

timeout.description: Max seconds to block for 'wait' action. Returns partial output on timeout.

offset.description: Line offset for 'log' action (default: last 200 lines)

limit.description: Max lines to return for 'log' action

function.name: send_message
function.description:
Send a message to a connected messaging platform, or list available targets.

IMPORTANT: When the user asks to send to a specific channel or person (not just a bare platform name), call send_message(action='list') FIRST to see available targets, then send to the correct one.
If the user just says a platform name like 'send to telegram', send directly to the home channel without listing first.

action.description: Action to perform. 'send' (default) sends a message. 'list' returns all available channels/contacts across connected platforms.

target.description: Delivery target. Format: 'platform' (uses home channel), 'platform:#channel-name', 'platform:chat_id', or 'platform:chat_id:thread_id' for Telegram topics and Discord threads. Examples: 'telegram', 'telegram:-1001234567890:17585', 'discord:999888777:555444333', 'discord:#bot-home', 'slack:#engineering', 'signal:+155****4567', 'matrix:!roomid:server.org', 'matrix:@user:server.org', 'yuanbao:direct:<account_id>' (DM), 'yuanbao:group:<group_code>' (group chat)

message.description: The message text to send. To send an image or file, include MEDIA:<local_path> (e.g. 'MEDIA:/tmp/hermes/cache/img_xxx.jpg') in the message — the platform will deliver it as a native media attachment.

function.name: skill_manage
function.description:
Manage skills (create, update, delete). Skills are your procedural memory — reusable approaches for recurring task types. New skills go to ~/.hermes/skills/; existing skills can be modified wherever they live.

Actions: create (full SKILL.md + optional category), patch (old_string/new_string — preferred for fixes), edit (full SKILL.md rewrite — major overhauls only), delete, write_file, remove_file.

On delete, pass `absorbed_into=<umbrella>` when you're merging this skill's content into another one, or `absorbed_into=""` when you're pruning it with no forwarding target. This lets the curator tell consolidation from pruning without guessing, so downstream consumers (cron jobs that reference the old skill name, etc.) get updated correctly. The target you name in `absorbed_into` must already exist — create/patch the umbrella first, then delete.

Create when: complex task succeeded (5+ calls), errors overcome, user-corrected approach worked, non-trivial workflow discovered, or user asks you to remember a procedure.
Update when: instructions stale/wrong, OS-specific failures, missing steps or pitfalls found during use. If you used a skill and hit issues not covered by it, patch it immediately.

After difficult/iterative tasks, offer to save as a skill. Skip for simple one-offs. Confirm with user before creating/deleting.

Good skills: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls section, verification steps. Use skill_view() to see format examples.

Pinned skills are off-limits — all write actions refuse with a message pointing the user to `hermes curator unpin <name>`. Don't try to route around this by renaming or recreating.

name.description: Skill name (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Must match an existing skill for patch/edit/delete/write_file/remove_file.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content (YAML frontmatter + markdown body). Required for 'create' and 'edit'. For 'edit', read the skill first with skill_view() and provide the complete updated text.

old_string.description: Text to find in the file (required for 'patch'). Must be unique unless replace_all=true. Include enough surrounding context to ensure uniqueness.

new_string.description: Replacement text (required for 'patch'). Can be empty string to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: For 'patch': replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false).

category.description: Optional category/domain for organizing the skill (e.g., 'devops', 'data-science', 'mlops'). Creates a subdirectory grouping. Only used with 'create'.

file_path.description: Path to a supporting file within the skill directory. For 'write_file'/'remove_file': required, must be under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. For 'patch': optional, defaults to SKILL.md if omitted.

file_content.description: Content for the file. Required for 'write_file'.

absorbed_into.description: For 'delete' only — declares intent so the curator can tell consolidation from pruning without guessing. Pass the umbrella skill name when this skill's content was merged into another (the target must already exist). Pass an empty string when the skill is truly stale and being pruned with no forwarding target. Omitting the arg on delete is supported for backward compatibility but downstream tooling (e.g. cron-job skill reference rewriting) will have to guess at intent.

function.name: terminal
function.description:
Execute shell commands on a Linux environment. Filesystem usually persists between calls.

Do NOT use cat/head/tail to read files — use read_file instead.
Do NOT use grep/rg/find to search — use search_files instead.
Do NOT use ls to list directories — use search_files(target='files') instead.
Do NOT use sed/awk to edit files — use patch instead.
Do NOT use echo/cat heredoc to create files — use write_file instead.
Reserve terminal for: builds, installs, git, processes, scripts, network, package managers, and anything that needs a shell.

Foreground (default): Commands return INSTANTLY when done, even if the timeout is high. Set timeout=300 for long builds/scripts — you'll still get the result in seconds if it's fast. Prefer foreground for short commands.
Background: Set background=true to get a session_id. Two patterns:
  (1) Long-lived processes that never exit (servers, watchers).
  (2) Long-running tasks with notify_on_complete=true — you can keep working on other things and the system auto-notifies you when the task finishes. Great for test suites, builds, deployments, or anything that takes more than a minute.
For servers/watchers, do NOT use shell-level background wrappers (nohup/disown/setsid/trailing '&') in foreground mode. Use background=true so Hermes can track lifecycle and output.
After starting a server, verify readiness with a health check or log signal, then run tests in a separate terminal() call. Avoid blind sleep loops.
Use process(action="poll") for progress checks, process(action="wait") to block until done.
Working directory: Use 'workdir' for per-command cwd.

# SOP Intent Router（含 Planner 能力）

## 触发条件
webhook 收到 `stage=intent-router`，payload 包含：
- `intent`: 用户意图文本（必填）
- `tg_chat_id`（可选）

---

## 你的职责（Hermes LLM）

**理解用户意图，决定执行路径。你同时是 Router 和 Planner。**

---

## Phase 1: 加载环境

```bash
set -a && source ~/.agent-brain-plugins.env 2>/dev/null; set +a
set -a && source ~/.hermes/.env 2>/dev/null; set +a
```

---

## Phase 2: 分析意图，判断复杂度

分析 `{intent}`，判断属于哪种情况：

### 情况 A：单任务 + 有 URL（最常见）
```
"翻译这篇文章 https://..."
"分析这个项目 https://github.com/..."
```
→ 直接执行，跳到 Phase 3

### 情况 B：多任务 + 有多个 URL
```
"翻译这两篇文章 https://... 和 https://..."
```
→ 拆成多个单任务，对每个 URL 分别执行 Phase 3

### 情况 C：有主题但没有 URL（需要搜索）
```
"研究 Anthropic 所有关于 Harness Engineering 的文章"
"帮我找 LLM scaling laws 相关的最新论文"
```
→ 先搜索获取 URL 列表，再对每个 URL 执行 Phase 3

---

## Phase 3: 单任务执行（每个 URL 执行一次）

### Step 3.1: 抓取内容
**web 来源：**
```bash
python3 __SKILL_DIR__/scripts/web_fetch.py {url} > /tmp/intent-raw.md
```

**非 web（github/arxiv/reddit）：**
```bash
python3 -c "print('# {url}\n\n**来源**: {url}\n**意图**: {intent}')" > /tmp/intent-raw.md
```

### Step 3.2: 写入并触发 pipeline
```bash
python3 __SKILL_DIR__/scripts/write_and_trigger.py \
  --content-file /tmp/intent-raw.md \
  --url "{url}" \
  --source-type {来源类型} \
  --action "{动作: translate/summarize/extract_key_points/translate_and_extract，无则留空}" \
  --intent "{intent}" \
  --tg-chat-id "{tg_chat_id}"
```

---

## Phase 4: 情况 C 搜索步骤

当没有具体 URL 时：

```bash
# 用 Gemini 搜索相关 URL
python3 -c "
import json, os, urllib.request

api_key = os.environ.get('GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY', '')
prompt = '''请找出关于「{topic}」的权威技术文章 URL 列表（3-5个），
只返回 JSON 数组: [\"url1\", \"url2\", ...]'''

payload = json.dumps({{'contents': [{{'role': 'user', 'parts': [{{'text': prompt}}]}}]}}).encode()
url = f'https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/publishers/google/models/gemini-2.0-flash-lite:generateContent?key={api_key}'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers={{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
    data = json.loads(r.read())
text = data['candidates'][0]['content']['parts'][0]['text']
import re
urls = re.findall(r'https?://[^\s\"\']+', text)
print(json.dumps(urls))
" > /tmp/search-urls.json

# 对每个 URL 执行 Phase 3
```

---

## 动作判断规则

| 用户说的 | action 参数 |
|---------|------------|
| 翻译 / translate / 中文 | `translate` |
| 总结 / summarize / 摘要 | `summarize` |
| 提炼 / 关键论点 / 核心 | `extract_key_points` |
| 翻译 + 提炼 | `translate_and_extract` |
| 研究 / 分析 / 看看 / 默认 | （空）|

---

## 多任务 TG 通知格式

多个任务时，在开始和结束发 TG 汇总：

开始时：
```
🧭 [INTENT-ROUTER] 多任务计划
   共 N 个任务
   Task 1: 翻译 https://...
   Task 2: 研究 https://...
   ...
```

全部提交后：
```
✅ [INTENT-ROUTER] N 个任务已提交
   各 pipeline 将自动执行，完成后分别通知
```

---

## 异常处理

- URL 无法抓取 → 用 URL 本身作为内容继续
- Pipeline 不存在 → write_and_trigger.py 自动创建
- 搜索返回空 → TG 告知用户无法找到相关内容

{"success": true, "name": "sop-intent-router", "file": "scripts/write_and_trigger.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
write_and_trigger.py: 将内容写入对应 pipeline 的 raw/ 目录并 git push 触发。
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

WIKI_BASE = Path.home() / "wiki"

# 追踪参数黑名单（通用，不感知 source_type）
_TRACKING_PARAMS = {"si", "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign",
                    "utm_term", "utm_content", "ref", "feature", "mc_cid"}


def normalize_url(url: str) -> str:
    """去掉追踪参数，返回规范化 URL（不做 youtu.be→youtube.com 等转换）。"""
    from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlencode, parse_qs, urlunparse
    try:
        p = urlparse(url)
        qs = {k: v for k, v in parse_qs(p.query).items()
              if k.lower() not in _TRACKING_PARAMS}
        return urlunparse(p._replace(query=urlencode(qs, doseq=True)))
    except Exception:
        return url


def find_existing_by_url(source_dir: Path, url: str) -> Path | None:
    """在 source_dir 下找 frontmatter 含 source_url 匹配的文件。"""
    normalized = normalize_url(url)
    for f in source_dir.glob("*.md"):
        try:
            text = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for line in text.splitlines()[:10]:   # frontmatter 在文件头
                if line.startswith("source_url:"):
                    existing_url = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                    if normalize_url(existing_url) == normalized:
                        return f
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


# URL 自动识别规则（优先于 LLM 传入的 source_type，防止误判）
URL_SOURCE_RULES = [
    (["youtube.com/watch", "youtu.be/", "youtube.com/shorts"], "youtube"),
    (["github.com/"], "github"),
    (["arxiv.org/abs", "arxiv.org/pdf"], "arxiv"),
    (["reddit.com/r/"], "reddit"),
    (["douyin.com/", "iesdouyin.com/"], "douyin"),
]


def detect_source_type(url: str, fallback: str) -> str:
    """从 URL 自动识别来源类型，避免 LLM 误判。"""
    url_lower = url.lower()
    for patterns, source in URL_SOURCE_RULES:
        if any(p in url_lower for p in patterns):
            return source
    return fallback


def log(msg):
    print(f"[write-trigger] {msg}", flush=True)


def send_tg(text: str):
    token = os.environ.get("YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN", "")
    chat_id = os.environ.get("YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_CHAT_ID", "")
    if not token or not chat_id:
        return
    try:
        subprocess.run([
            "curl", "-s", "-X", "POST",
            f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage",
            "-d", f"chat_id={chat_id}",
            "-d", "disable_web_page_preview=true",
            "--data-urlencode", f"text={text}",
            "--max-time", "10",
        ], capture_output=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


def find_pipeline(source_type: str) -> dict | None:
    for sop_file in WIKI_BASE.glob("*/sop.yaml"):
        try:
            sop = yaml.safe_load(sop_file.read_text())
            for stage in sop.get("pipeline", []):
                trigger = stage.get("trigger", "")
                if source_type in trigger or f"{source_type}-links" in trigger:
                    source_dir = (stage.get("params", {}).get("source_dir") or
                                  trigger.split("/**")[0])
                    return {
                        "pipeline_name": sop["name"],
                        "wiki_local_path": sop["wiki_local_path"],
                        "source_dir": source_dir,
                    }
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


def create_pipeline(source_type: str, tg_chat_id: str) -> bool:
    secret = "L84zG48C1OeuwNXz8d7myEttQGjWkXrfOfWBJAHXMJs"
    payload = json.dumps({
        "pipeline_name": f"{source_type}-wiki",
        "source_type": source_type,
        "stages": "wiki-build,tg-notify",
        "github_account": "divanoo65",
        "tg_chat_id": tg_chat_id,
        "source_dir": f"{source_type}-links",
    })
    r = subprocess.run([
        "curl", "-s", "-X", "POST",
        "http://localhost:8644/webhooks/sop-pipeline-creator",
        "-H", "Content-Type: application/json",
        "-H", f"X-Gitlab-Token: {secret}",
        "-d", payload,
    ], capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        return json.loads(r.stdout).get("status") == "accepted"
    except Exception:
        return False


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--content-file", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--url", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-type", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--tg-chat-id", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--action", default="",
                        help="内容变换动作: translate/summarize/extract_key_points")
    parser.add_argument("--intent", default="", help="原始用户意图（用于 TG 通知）")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    tg_chat_id = args.tg_chat_id or os.environ.get("YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_CHAT_ID", "")

    # URL 自动识别覆盖 LLM 传入的 source_type，防止误判
    detected = detect_source_type(args.url, args.source_type)
    if detected != args.source_type:
        log(f"source_type 自动修正: {args.source_type} → {detected} (url={args.url})")
    args.source_type = detected

    # TG 开始通知
    intent_short = args.intent[:60] + "..." if len(args.intent) > 60 else args.intent
    send_tg(f"🧭 [INTENT-ROUTER] 意图收到\n{intent_short}\n⏳ 正在路由...")
    content = Path(args.content_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    pipeline = find_pipeline(args.source_type)
    if not pipeline:
        log(f"未找到 {args.source_type} pipeline，创建中...")
        ok = create_pipeline(args.source_type, tg_chat_id)
        if ok:
            import time
            wiki_path = WIKI_BASE / f"{args.source_type}-wiki"
            for _ in range(18):
                time.sleep(5)
                if (wiki_path / "sop.yaml").exists():
                    pipeline = find_pipeline(args.source_type)
                    break
        if not pipeline:
            print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": "pipeline 创建失败"}))
            sys.exit(1)

        # 新建 pipeline 需要设置 GitHub Actions variable
        source = __import__("subprocess")
        gh_token = os.environ.get("DIVANOO65_GITHUB_TOKEN", os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", ""))
        if gh_token:
            source.run([
                "curl", "-s", "-X", "POST",
                "-H", f"Authorization: Bearer {gh_token}",
                "-H", "Content-Type: application/json",
                "-d", '{"name":"HERMES_WEBHOOK_TOKEN","value":"L84zG48C1OeuwNXz8d7myEttQGjWkXrfOfWBJAHXMJs"}',
                f"https://api.github.com/repos/divanoo65/{args.source_type}-wiki/actions/variables"
            ], capture_output=True)

    wiki_path = Path(pipeline["wiki_local_path"]).expanduser()

    # ── 数据契约强制执行 ──────────────────────────────────────
    # raw/web-links/   = 原始内容，永远保留，不覆盖已有原文
    # raw/web-transformed/ = 处理后内容，由 content-transform 写入
    # 任何 action 都不改变这个契约
    source_dir = Path(pipeline["source_dir"])
    if not source_dir.is_absolute():
        source_dir = wiki_path / source_dir
    source_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ── Stage A 写入：始终 ADDED（保证 sop_router 能触发 Stage B）──────────
    # 幂等逻辑在 Stage C，Stage A 职责只是"把 URL 放入队列"
    normalized_url = normalize_url(args.url)
    slug = re.sub(r'[^\w-]', '-',
                  args.url.split("//")[-1].split("/")[-1] or
                  args.url.split("//")[-1].replace("/", "-"))[:60]
    slug = slug.strip("-") or "content"
    dest = source_dir / f"{slug}.md"

    # 文件已存在：加时间戳确保 ADDED（git diff-filter=A 能检测到）
    if dest.exists():
        from datetime import datetime as _dt
        ts = _dt.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')
        dest = source_dir / f"{slug}-{ts}.md"
        log(f"文件已存在，新建: {dest}")

    # source_url 写入 frontmatter（canonical ID，Stage C 用于幂等查重）
    frontmatter_lines = ["---", f"source_url: {normalized_url}"]
    if args.action:
        frontmatter_lines.append(f"action: {args.action}")
    frontmatter_lines.append("---")
    final_content = "\n".join(frontmatter_lines) + "\n\n" + content

    dest.write_text(final_content, encoding="utf-8")
    log(f"写入 {dest}" + (f" [action={args.action}]" if args.action else ""))

    # ── 数据总线：写 source_url 到 pipeline-context.json ──────────────────
    # 所有后续 stage 通过 pipeline-context.json 获取 source_url，不依赖各自文件 frontmatter
    ctx_file = wiki_path / "raw" / "pipeline-context.json"
    ctx_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx = {}
    if ctx_file.exists():
        try:
            ctx = json.loads(ctx_file.read_text())
        except Exception:
            pass
    ctx["source_url"] = normalized_url
    ctx["source_type"] = args.source_type
    ctx_file.write_text(json.dumps(ctx, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    log(f"pipeline-context.json 写入 source_url={normalized_url}")

    # git push
    try:
        subprocess.run(["git", "pull", "--rebase", "origin", "main"],
                       cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", str(dest)], cwd=wiki_path, check=True,
                       capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m",
                        f"feat: add {slug} [{args.source_type}]"],
                       cwd=wiki_path, check=True, capture_output=True)
        r = subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"],
                           cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            subprocess.run(["git", "pull", "--rebase", "origin", "main"],
                           cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True)
            subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"],
                           cwd=wiki_path, check=True, capture_output=True)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        log(f"git 失败: {e}")
        print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "message": str(e)}))
        sys.exit(1)

    # TG 完成通知
    action_label = f" [{args.action}]" if args.action else ""
    send_tg(
        f"✅ [INTENT-ROUTER] 路由完成{action_label}\n"
        f"📍 Pipeline: {pipeline['pipeline_name']}\n"
        f"🔗 {args.url}\n"
        f"⏳ Stage C/D 将自动执行..."
    )

    result = {
        "status": "triggered",
        "pipeline": pipeline["pipeline_name"],
